description: Builds UNSIGNED Base Sepolia transactions to place a limit order on an SMX testnet event market from your own wallet: Account.submitOrder on your own SMX Account, plus any needed Factory requestAccess/deployAccount, test USDC mint/approve and Account.deposit. Refuses closed or halted markets. Fee 0.25%. Returns {to, data, value, chainId, gas} per step; sign them yourself in order. This server never signs or holds keys.

limitPrice.description: Limit price in cents of the chosen outcome, 1-99 (1% grid).

mintTestUsdc.description: Add a test USDC mint step if the wallet lacks collateral. Default true.

wallet.description: Your own wallet address (EOA that owns the SMX Account). Never a private key.

name: smx_build_order
title: SMX: build an unsigned order
